selection_basis: All ten previously selected environments rerun with a 25-degree camera half-angle. No environment, wind, Gaussian sensing quality or optimizer retuning. Same paired seed9101 and five-minute duration. After a slalom baseline contact, a common50Hz execution-filter update rate is tested instead of20Hz, with the original buffers unchanged. The invalid0.9m-buffer trial is retained separately. This is a development sensing-range revision, not a held-out benchmark; small and unfavorable outcomes are not removed.

slalom.protocol_note: Both planners use 50 Hz execution-filter updates here (20 Hz in the previous checkpoint), with the same original 0.7 m execution buffer and 0.6 m geometric planning clearance. The 20 Hz narrower-footprint baseline contacted a building; that failed pair is retained and excluded from this comparison.
